bugs_found: cmd_all uses min() for profile-validate result, so profile validation failures can be ignored and the command may exit 0 despite an invalid profile.
contract-presence/contract-validate/floats-check do not catch YAML parse errors or non-mapping profiles from load_profile, causing crashes instead of documented exit code 2.

cmd_review_validate and cmd_review_gate load schema/review files without handling FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError for schemas, so malformed/missing configuration can crash rather than return a config error.
review-gate overwrites findings by lexicographic filename order, not by round number, so round-10 sorts before round-2 and stale acknowledgements can incorrectly determine gate status.
review-gate claims the latest overall round must approve but never actually checks the latest round overall verdict, only the code-reviewer verdict.
